summary: Stage a readable miniature greeting with distinct anticipation, gesture and settle poses.
objective: Create a lantern keeper who notices me, raises a light and settles into a greeting.
example_prompts: Create a lantern keeper who notices me, raises a light and settles into a greeting.
Let me inspect the puppet joints and adjust the wave amplitude.

entities.name: Puppet body
entities.guidance: Separate head, torso, pelvis, upper/lower limbs and mitten hands; preserve silhouette gaps.

entities.name: Lantern prop
entities.guidance: Build frame, handle and inset luminous chamber with a grasp attachment point.

entities.name: Small stage
entities.guidance: Include a shallow plinth and unobstructed gesture envelope.

object_craft.structure: Separate head, torso, pelvis, upper/lower limbs and mitten hands; preserve silhouette gaps.
object_craft.material: Painted wood with matte cloth sleeves.
object_craft.articulation: Local shoulder, elbow and wrist pivots; no scaling to reach.

object_craft.structure: Build frame, handle and inset luminous chamber with a grasp attachment point.
object_craft.material: Dark metal frame and translucent warm panes.
object_craft.articulation: Parent to the hand grip only while held.

object_craft.structure: Include a shallow plinth and unobstructed gesture envelope.
object_craft.material: Quiet felt backdrop with soft contact shadow.

state_contract.model: Authored finite performance: idle, notice, lift, wave, settle; normalized clip time and immutable rest pose.
state_contract.authority: Domain state owns identities, values and accepted transitions. Derive labels and meshes from that state; camera and display offsets are separate.
actions: Select a joint to reveal its pivot.

invariants: Lantern remains attached to the same hand grip throughout the wave.
Feet remain on authored stage anchors; changing amplitude cannot move the root.
Scrubbing to the same time yields the same pose.
motion_guidance: Use overlapping but bounded head and wrist timing, with an anticipation pause before the main wave.
Three.js or another companion renderer owns skinning, picking and shadow inspection; the authored clip owns pose timing.
known_limits: Performance animation, not muscle forces or balance simulation.
Extreme pose edits need silhouette and self-intersection inspection.
Authored recipe only; runtime and rendered geometry checks have not run.
creative_affordances: Warm lantern focus motivates the greeting and makes its direction legible.

physical_contract.scope: Authored planted puppet acting, no rigid-body contacts.
colliders: Stage anchors and a visible gesture envelope; no collision solver.
contact: Feet stay at fixed support marks.
physical_contract.timestep: Use a declared fixed update step for changing model state; interpolate presentation only. Pause clears accumulated playback time.
checks: Check hand grip and ground anchors at lift and settle.
